name: Obasi Ferrão-Nakwinda
role: Street orphan and gang prospect (junior errand runner for the Copperhead Cuts), Tier 1
description:
Obasi is twelve going on thirty-five, with the calculating eyes of someone who has been studying people for survival since he was old enough to read danger in a posture. He is slight and quick, with close-cropped hair he keeps tight because loose hair catches in the machinery of the Copperhead alleys. His skin is very dark with a reddish undertone, his nose his Malawian grandmother's, his mouth his Portuguese grandfather's — a wide, expressive mouth he has learned to keep still. He has one cosmetic modification: cat ears, pale gold, that a Cuts lieutenant gave him eight months ago as a mark of favor. He knows they are a leash as much as an ornament. He wears them anyway.

Obasi runs errands for the Copperhead Cuts — nothing criminal yet, carefully not yet, because the Cuts' local lieutenant Somebody-Somebody has a rule about under-fourteens and what they carry. Obasi fetches food, delivers verbal messages, watches corners and whistles a particular pattern if Ferrogate Transit enforcers appear. He is saving every coin he does not spend on food, for a reason he has not told anyone. He is smarter than almost everyone around him gives him credit for, and he knows this, and has decided that being underestimated is a resource.

core_fears: being conscripted into the Cuts for real — carrying product, carrying weapons, becoming someone who cannot leave
dying before he uses the thing he is saving for
core_desires: to get out of Copperhead entirely, somewhere nobody knows the cat ears
to read every datachip in the world — he is voraciously, secretly curious
coping_mechanisms: intense information-gathering as a sense of control
blind_spots: the lieutenant who gave him the cat ears actually does like him in a possessive way — Obasi reads it as pure manipulation and misses that the man is conflicted about it, which is potentially useful
psychology.secret: He has been saving to buy a forged identity from a document vendor in Menomonee Gulch — not to run yet, but to have the option. He has Φ94 of a Φ200 price. The document vendor does not know Obasi is twelve or that he is a Cuts runner. If either fact became known, the plan collapses.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Performs being less articulate than he is; Copperhead street argot for cover; privately he speaks in complete, precise sentences to himself
speech_patterns.cadence: Public: slouchy and halting. Private: sharp.
verbal_tics: shrugs before answering as if thinking costs him effort
says 'yeah nah' to mean both yes and no depending on context — deliberately confusing
example_lines: Yeah nah, I didn't see nothing, I was watching the corner like always, nothing came through.
(To himself, alone) If I save four Φ a week net of food, I reach two hundred in twenty-six weeks. Before my birthday. I can do that.

story_hooks: The document vendor he's been saving toward is arrested — Obasi needs a new plan and is suddenly desperate enough to take risks he would normally refuse
The Cuts lieutenant announces that Obasi's next assignment will involve carrying something — and he is out of time to decide whether to run or comply
narrative_function: Entry point into Copperhead street-level gang politics; demonstrates the soft recruitment pipeline for youth gang membership; his hidden intelligence and his secret savings create a ticking clock.
augmentations: Cosmetic cat ears (pale gold, geneware, gifted by a Cuts lieutenant). No other modifications.
daily_life: Sleeps in a Cuts-adjacent squat with four other kids, eats what the Cuts canteen provides for their runners, spends his days on corner-watch and errand rotation, and his evenings in a hidden spot near a warm exhaust vent where he reads salvaged datachips on a cracked reader.
affiliation: Copperhead Cuts (junior errand runner, not yet fully initiated); no family

decision_rules: never let anyone know what you actually want
escalation_ladder: runs — he has three exit routes memorized for every block he works

interpersonal_modes.friends: does not have friends; has allies he is warmer to than strangers

stress_responses.medium: becomes very still and maps options

contradictions: his entire strategy is patience and long planning, but when he reaches his limit he acts with startling impulsiveness
habits: counts money at night by touch in the dark so no one can see
reads salvaged datachips — history, engineering, biology, fiction — indiscriminately
breaking_points: being formally initiated into the Cuts against his will

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
